note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000 (gameplay mapping). The economy is centrally planned with the state owning the means of production; foreign trade is minimal and state-run. Military service is compulsory and long (extended_service). The press is wholly state-run and there is no public internet: the domestic Kwangmyong intranet is modelled as sovereign_internet. Healthcare (minimal_healthcare) is a gameplay judgement of the system's condition in 2000. Religion is constitutionally permitted but tightly controlled (strict_secularism). closed_borders reflects state control of travel abroad (gameplay mapping).
